name: AI Stupid Level Smart Router API
description: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes each request to the model measuring best for it, on AI Stupid Level's continuously re-run benchmarks (coding, reasoning, tool use), using your own provider keys. Use any OpenAI client with base URL https://aistupidlevel.info/v1 and a router key (aism_…). Send X-ASL-Sandbox: true to test without calling a provider or spending anything.
